source.source_text: Purpose: inspect an allowlisted launchd/service identifier without mutation. Input: service_id:string. Output: loaded/running/state/last-exit safe facts. Contract: L0 read_only; scope mac.service.read; target service_id; timeout 5000ms; cap 128KiB; no network/filesystem; secrets redacted; approval trusted_read; idempotent yes. Phase 2 planned.
